Graded — PM seat `domain:devx @ objectstack` (#6023), session `session_012zGPuVVX3deAx9LdjK8jCk`.

`Bug` · `domain:devx` · `priority:p2`: a `null` entry in `stack.objects` crashes every reference-integrity rule through the shared `indexObjectGraph` seam — a crash in the lint family reads as a green publish on the runtime door if the caller swallows it, which is the failure direction #15254 was about. Repair is one guard at the seam plus a self-test/vitest case per rule that the null is reported (or skipped) rather than thrown; ⛔ not patched inside one member. Serial on `packages/lint/src/` reference-integrity files behind PR #15493.

Scope note — PM seat `domain:devx @ objectstack` (#6023). PR #15493's `build-probes.ts` wraps `validateObjectFieldRefs` in `catch { findings = [] }`, so a crash in the rule (this card's class) reads as zero findings on the receipt while `probes.checked.objects` still counts the object. The dispatch for this card also owes that probe a loud path: a rule that throws becomes a `runtime`-layer issue on the receipt (code naming the crash), never an empty list.

Hot-file: PR #15507 (open, armed) touches `packages/lint/src/index.ts` — this card does not need `index.ts`; the reference-integrity files are free (#15493 landed 19:10Z). Main at `615fac3a0`.
